title: Human Review Workflow for Case-Only Author Conflict
builds_on: Phase 4Y (final decision A, CASE_ONLY_POLICY_APPROVED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW) and its discovered executor-bypass gap

task_a_audit.case_only_conflict_grain_needed: (SurvivorPaperID, LoserPaperID, UserID) -> two already-fixed AuthorNameRaw variants -- pair-comparison shape
task_a_audit.reviewer_identity: request.user.user_id, permission via _can_reconcile() (manage_users perm or Admin user_type)
task_a_audit.status_transition_guard: FOR UPDATE row lock + 409 Conflict if already decided
task_a_audit.critical_finding: review_queue_decide() on CONFIRMED performs an immediate INSERT INTO Authors (ON CONFLICT UserID,PaperID DO UPDATE) in the same transaction -- decision and write are coupled, not separable
task_a_audit.q1_reason: wrong grain -- no column for a second PaperID, no comparison-type field, no place for plan fingerprint/JournalID/DOI/tenant context
task_a_audit.q2_reason: no such field exists in AuthorReviewQueue at all
task_a_audit.q3_reviewer_can_approve_reject: generically yes via Status enum, but CONFIRMED is inseparable from a specific unrelated Authors write
task_a_audit.q4_approval_meaning: approve AND immediately write a specific co-author link -- closer to narrow execution authorization than to pure evidence
task_a_audit.q5_field: Status='CONFIRMED' itself, by original design, for its actual use case
task_a_audit.conclusion: genuine schema/semantic mismatch, not forced into a workaround

task_b_state_machine.smallest_missing_capability: a review-decision representation whose terminal states are pure data, not paired with any write -- provided by this phase's two new functions, with no new persisted table

task_c_data_contract.disclaimer_text: This review does NOT authorize merge execution.

task_d_review_decision_semantics.APPROVED_meaning: evidence that a human reviewer, having seen the full display contract and disclaimer, agrees the difference is formatting-only
task_d_review_decision_semantics.REJECTED_meaning: human reviewer disagrees or judges the difference unsafe despite the classifier label; terminal, no further progression
task_d_review_decision_semantics.PENDING_meaning: HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED state, no decision recorded yet
task_d_review_decision_semantics.proof_method: direct test (not inspection only) -- test_phase_4z_reviewed_approved_state_still_does_not_unblock_executor reaches REVIEWED_APPROVED via the pure state machine, snapshots mock-cursor MergeApproval/ResearchPaper before and after (byte-identical), then calls execute_approved_merge() on the identical fixture and confirms EXEC_BLOCKED_AUTHOR_CONFLICT still returned

task_e_implementation.reason: AuthorReviewQueue is schematically incompatible (wrong grain, decision-coupled-to-write); smallest safe representation is two new pure functions with no DB access, reusing existing plan/conflict dict shapes from Phase 4E/4Y

task_e_applicable_note: path B taken (minimal implementation), not path A (existing infra sufficient) -- existing infra was found genuinely insufficient per Task A

required_cases_covered.case: review approval does NOT make execute_approved_merge() executable
review decision does not modify MergeApproval automatically
review decision does not modify ResearchPaper
review decision does not modify DOI
required_cases_covered.test: covered by ResearchPaper snapshot equality (DOI is a ResearchPaper column) + source-level purity guard

required_cases_covered.case: case-only review does not affect 5548/5549 or 6107/6109
existing exact conflict behavior remains unchanged
existing executor safety tests remain green
